fire: The potters fired their bowls in two brick kilns behind the workshop.
The blacksmith kept three heavy anvils near the forge.
The gardeners cleaned their trowels before putting them away.
Soup was served from large copper ladles at the festival.
The art room had six wooden easels by the window.
Flour was passed through fine sieves to remove the lumps.
Old letters were written with goose quills and black ink.
The beekeeper checked the hives every morning in spring.

The art room had six wooden chairs by the window.

Old letters were written with a pen and black ink.
